Vendored from Google Fonts (variable font, latin subset only — this app
is English-only, so the cyrillic/greek/vietnamese subsets Google also
serves aren't needed):
  Inter v20 (variable, weight axis 100-900) -> Inter-Variable-latin.woff2

To upgrade: fetch the CSS for the weights you need from
https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600;700&display=swap
with a real browser User-Agent (Google serves woff2 URLs only to
recognized browsers), take the "latin" block's src URL (requesting
multiple weights together like this returns one variable-font file
covering the whole range — that's intentional, not a bug), and download
it to Inter-Variable-latin.woff2.
